Parallel Web Systems, a startup from former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal, has secured US$100m in a Series A funding round. The investment round was co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Index Ventures with participation from other backers, including Khosla Ventures.

Founded in 2023 and officially launched in August 2025, Parallel Web Systems develops APIs that enable AI systems to search the live web for current information needed to perform tasks.
